searchText: LFR https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/449 TL/DR, simplifying the validators endpoint to map more closely to the actual validators type, and providing an identities endpoint in 452 - looks like 452 is fairly well accepted but don't want to take that as acceptance of 449 There doesn't seem to be consensus on removing the index field and making the return value of the call a simple set of spec validator objects, as opposed to having a non-spec object that contains the spec validator plus its index. I think that needs to be nailed down before we can proceed with the last tidy ups and look to merge this. while I have a slight preference to keep it, I am ok with removing it and query both apis i just think if <@308223150725005322> <@654267572107083777> <@602753420033785856> could give some feedback may be helpful at this point

excerpts.content: There doesn't seem to be consensus on removing the index field and making the return value of the call a simple set of spec validator objects, as opposed to having a non-spec object that contains the spec validator plus its index.  I think that needs to be nailed down before we can proceed with the last tidy ups and look to merge this.
